rationale_one_line: Addy writes structured engineering essays about agents, so a magazine-edit serif voice on warm paper matches his register better than a hacker mono palette.
writing_tone_notes: Pattern-recognition, builder POV, declarative. No hedging. Echoes Addy's essay voice (Beyond Vibe Coding, The Factory Model). Bold serif headlines, single accent phrase per scene, italic tag at the close.
do_rules: use the warm-paper canvas and deep-ink serif of the editorial baseline
reserve the clay accent for one phrase per scene maximum
trim every line until each scene says one thing
dont_rules: do not switch to neon or hacker palettes (mono aesthetic was scored and rejected as off-register for Addy's voice)
do not stack accents across multiple lines in the same scene
do not add emojis, em or en dashes, semicolons, body colons, or arrows
do not introduce sycophancy or hype filler
history_check: reports/style-history.json was empty before this run, so no last-14 collision possible.
